seriesTitle: New Zealand Spy (جاسوس نیوزلند) زیرنویس فارسی

episodes.title: The Recruits
episodes.summary: After 2 weeks of training, New Zealand's newest spies — and the only 3 who applied — Michael Riviera, Sue Nightingale, and Michael Anderson are thrown into their first mission.

episodes.title: The Games
episodes.summary: Undercover as an athlete, coach, and chef, the spies are sent to Christchurch for the 1974 Unity Games to protect the Indian Foreign Minister from being assassinated.

episodes.title: The Informant
episodes.summary: Ignoring Boss's orders to rest and recuperate, Michael follows a lead to a Marlborough vineyard. Meanwhile, Sue teams up with a British spy in hopes of uncovering valuable information.

episodes.title: The Train
episodes.summary: On a train to Auckland, the spies hatch a daring plan to intercept a briefcase of classified New Zealand documents before it lands in the hands of Dennis Green in the next carriage over.

episodes.title: The Island
episodes.summary: Michael travels to the Abel Tasman to save Anderson — only to be betrayed by a familiar face.

episodes.title: The End
episodes.summary: With only hours before Dennis Green's plan succeeds, the spies must act fast — and together — to save the nation they swore to protect.
